newsitem.title: USA: Pakistan to seek 350,000 T soft wheat - embassy.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan to seek 350,000 T soft wheat - embassy.

text.p: Pakistan will seek later this month approximately 350,000 tonnes of optional origin soft white wheat for September 11-October 10 delivery, a Pakistan embassy official said.
"I expect it will be for this amount," the embassy official told Reuters in a telephone interview from Washington D.C.
But he noted the amount was subject to confirmation.
"We are calling for tenders around August 27," the official said.
The wheat will come from from the United States, Canada and Australia, he added.
"We have GSM credit for $25 million from the U.S.," he said. "We have Canadian Wheat Board credit for another shipload which is 50,000 tonnes and we have Australian credit for about four shiploads."
The official added that Pakistan was also seeking wheat during the first half of September under the PL-480 Title I export program which is part of the U.S. Department of Agriculture.

"Along with that, we are also going to be inviting tenders for procuring wheat under the PL-480 Title I program run by the USDA," he said. "That will be a separate tender, probably called during the first or second week of September," he said.
